feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 8 (y=0.07 m, ±0.065 m, 16 mm, 0.03 m speed, 56.40) is the best raced design, and this candidate is that design unchanged. Iteration 10 already tested the ±0.08 m spread at y=0.07 m and scored 35.98, with s-bend progress collapsing to 0.04 and slalom line loss unchanged. So your proposed ±0.08 m change is not new evidence, and I did not adopt it. Iteration 9 (y=0.067 m) lost s-bend progress and raised s-bend line loss to 0.5 per run, so the lead must stay at 0.07 m. Iteration 6 (wheel_radius 0.04 m) brought line loss back, so speed stays at 0.03 m. Iteration 7 (y=0.065 m, ±0.065 m) also lost slalom line and fell to s-bend progress 0.04. Next race (for your records, since no further geometry iterations remain): if the final track shows bend line loss, the cause is the lead or speed, which the evidence says to keep fixed. Do not widen beyond ±0.065 m.
